name: Medusa
source:
A famous monster with snakes for hair. A gaze from her magic eyes can also turn anyone to stone. Using this power, they are known for playing with men as they slowly turn them to stone. Since they have to both feed their snake hair and maintain their own high magic power, they require lots of semen. Due to that, they are always hungry for more men to play with. Utilizing both her own body and her snake hair, she will do everything she can to force the male to feed her.

In addition, if she finds a man she likes she may just rape him for fun. With tiny feelers inside her vagina that are similar to her snake hair, no man is able to resist her for long.

[From In-game Monsterpedia]
